flagged.evidence: The page says “a grid-norm stability claim reaches the common space only under uniform operator and norm-comparison bounds.” Those bounds are sufficient hypotheses in the Statement of lem-grid-stability-transfers-under-uniform-norm-comparison, not necessary for a particular family. For a counterexample, use the mesh norm from ex-mesh-grid-norm-hides-common-space-instability, but set Q_m=I on each grid, with U=I, P_m truncation, and R_m inclusion. Then S_m=R_mP_m+I(I-R_mP_m)=I, so both grid powers and lifted powers are stable. Yet ||R_m e_{m-1}||_∞=1 while ||e_{m-1}||_{G_m}=m, so there is no uniform lower reconstruction comparison; also ||P_m||≥m. Thus stability does transfer in this case without the stated bounds.
